name: tire-service
description: Tyre service carried out on a fleet vehicle: invoice, work order and/or tyre report from a tyre supplier. Layouts and languages (NL, BE-NL/FR, SE) vary per supplier.

fields.name: supplierName
fields.description: Company that carried out the service, e.g. 'QTeam Noord NV', 'Vianor AB'

fields.name: documentNumber
fields.description: Invoice, work order or reservation number of the supplier

fields.name: documentDate
fields.description: Date of the invoice/work order (ISO yyyy-mm-dd)

fields.name: purchaseOrderNumber
fields.description: Customer's purchase order (Bestelbon), e.g. HFS0028875

fields.name: licensePlate
fields.description: Registration or fleet ID of the vehicle/trailer, without spaces or dashes, e.g. OR18DH

fields.name: mileageKm
fields.description: Odometer reading in km (Kilometerstand / Mileage / Km. stand)

fields.name: serviceLocation
fields.description: Where the service took place, e.g. breakdown address

fields.name: tireSize
fields.description: Tyre dimension, normalised as e.g. 385/65 R22.5

fields.name: tireChanges
fields.description: One entry per tyre that was changed. A bundle can hold several handwritten sheets, each for a different tyre change

fields.name: position
fields.description: Axle position as written on the Document, e.g. 2R1, 6

fields.name: removedBrandModel
fields.description: Brand and model of the removed tyre, brand written out in full (e.g. 'Bridge R179' → 'Bridgestone R179'); no size or load index

fields.name: removedTreadDepthMm
fields.description: Tread depth of the removed tyre in mm

fields.name: removedSerial
fields.description: Serial number of the removed tyre

fields.name: mountedBrandModel
fields.description: Brand and model of the mounted tyre, brand written out in full (e.g. 'AP ENDURACE RT2' → 'Apollo Endurace RT2'); no size or load index

fields.name: mountedSerial
fields.description: Serial number of the mounted tyre

fields.name: reasonForRemoval
fields.description: Why the tyre was removed, e.g. tread worn, puncture

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO currency code, e.g. EUR, SEK

fields.name: totalExclVat
fields.description: Total amount excluding VAT

fields.name: vatAmount
fields.description: Total VAT amount

fields.name: totalInclVat
fields.description: Total amount including VAT
